description: The chart illustrates the number of hateful communication datasets per year, broken down by country categories shown in the legend. The horizontal axis contains the categories as years from 2012 through 2022 in chronological order and is labeled “Year.” The vertical axis is labeled “Number of datasets” and uses a logarithmic scale with major tick marks at approximately \(10^0\), \(10^1\), and \(10^2\) (covering roughly 1 to a bit over 100 datasets). For each year, multiple narrow bars are grouped side-by-side by country category, with colors indicated in the legend: Other (blue), USA (orange), IN (green), UK (red), IT (purple), and DE (brown). Approximate bar heights by year are: 2012 shows USA at about 2; 2013 shows USA at about 2; 2014 shows Other about 2 and USA about 1; 2015 shows Other about 3 and DE about 1; 2016 shows USA about 7, Other about 4, IN about 3, and UK about 2; 2017 shows Other about 18, USA about 14, UK about 9, IT about 5, IN about 1, and DE near 1; 2018 shows Other about 30, USA about 12, and IN/UK/IT/DE each around 4; 2019 shows Other about 50, USA about 16, IN about 6, IT about 8, and UK about 2; 2020 shows Other about 85, USA about 40, DE about 18, UK about 15, IN about 12, and IT about 2; 2021 shows Other just over 100, USA about 45, IN about 25, UK about 17, IT about 12, and DE about 9; 2022 shows a light-blue bar (Other) around 25, a light-green bar (IN) around 9, a light-red bar (UK) around 8, an orange bar (USA) around 3, and a purple bar (IT) around 1 (with no clearly visible DE bar). The bars are not sorted by height within each year; they are arranged as grouped categories per year, and there are no visible annotations or special emphasis beyond the legend and color coding.
